title: ""
page-layout: full
format:
  html:
    css:
      - styles.css
      - mathematician.css
---

```{=html}
<div class="site-shell">

{{< include includes/_header.html >}}

  <main class="quiz-page">

    <section class="quiz-intro" id="quiz-intro">

      <h1 class="interior-title">
        WHICH FAMOUS<br>
        MATHEMATICIAN<br>
        ARE YOU?
      </h1>

      <div class="quiz-intro-grid">

        <p class="quiz-dek">
          Twelve highly scientific questions. Eight mathematically
          questionable personality types. One inevitable result.
        </p>

      </div>

    <button class="quiz-start" id="quiz-start" type="button">
      BEGIN CLASSIFICATION ↗
    </button>

    </section>


    <section class="quiz-machine" id="quiz-machine" hidden>

      <div class="quiz-status">
        <span class="fig-label" id="question-counter">QUESTION 01 / 12</span>

        <div
          class="quiz-progress"
          role="progressbar"
          aria-label="Quiz progress"
          aria-valuemin="0"
          aria-valuemax="12"
          aria-valuenow="1"
        >
          <span id="quiz-progress-bar"></span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="quiz-question-wrap">

        <h2 id="question-text"></h2>

        <div
          class="quiz-answers"
          id="quiz-answers"
          aria-live="polite"
        ></div>

      </div>

      <button class="quiz-back" id="quiz-back" type="button">
        ← PREVIOUS
      </button>

    </section>


    <section class="quiz-result" id="quiz-result" hidden>

      <div class="result-heading">

        <div class="fig-label">
          FIG. 04A / CLASSIFICATION COMPLETE
        </div>

        <div class="result-kicker">
          YOU ARE
        </div>

        <h2 id="result-name"></h2>

        <div class="result-type" id="result-type"></div>

      </div>


      <div class="result-grid">

        <div class="result-copy">

          <p class="result-summary" id="result-summary"></p>

          <dl class="result-facts">
            <div>
              <dt>AT A PARTY</dt>
              <dd id="result-party"></dd>
            </div>

            <div>
              <dt>MATHEMATICAL MENACE</dt>
              <dd id="result-menace"></dd>
            </div>

            <div>
              <dt>NATURAL HABITAT</dt>
              <dd id="result-habitat"></dd>
            </div>

            <div>
              <dt>QUIZ MOTTO</dt>
              <dd id="result-motto"></dd>
            </div>
          </dl>

        </div>


        <div class="result-profile">

          <div class="profile-title">
            PERSONALITY VECTOR
          </div>

          <div class="profile-bars" id="profile-bars"></div>

        </div>

      </div>


      <div class="result-footer">

        <div class="result-match">
          MATCH SCORE /
          <span id="result-score"></span>
        </div>

        <button class="quiz-retake" id="quiz-retake" type="button">
          RECLASSIFY ME ↗
        </button>

      </div>

    </section>

  </main>


{{< include includes/_footer.html >}}

</div>

<script src="./mathematician.js?v=1"></script>
```
